# New Event: Neurological Warfare (All Rewards and Nuke Placement / Skyline Valley)

![New Event: Neurological Warfare (All Rewards and Nuke Placement / Skyline Valley)](/uploads/358_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

A lot of news awaits you in the **Skyline Valley Update (June 2024)** with the **map expansion** in southern Appalachia in Shenandoah National Park. One of them is a new endgame event called "Neurological Warfare". The event takes place at the **Hawksbill Weather Station** arena in northern Skyline Valley. 

Like the Queen, Earle Williams or the Ultrazit Titan, this endgame event is also triggered via a **nuclear missile**. However, with one difference. **Any impact zone in the new area triggers the event.** The nuke also does not destroy camps or kill players in Skyline Valley. And the impact zone is NOT shown on the map. Not even under “World Activities”. After the nuke hits, the event starts and the weather changes throughout the Skyline Valley area. So the event and the missile status silo holotape are the only ways to tell if a nuke is active in Skyline Valley. I hope this will be made clearer at the release or later.

## Event sequence "Neurological Warfare"

As soon as you travel to the active event, you will land on the upper level in front of the arena. If you want to get there on foot, you have to walk to the **Hawksbill Weather Station** and take the elevator up there. You can actually jump from above over the mountains into the arena.

In the waiting area there are some workbenches and power armor stations as well as a stash box. All players meet there for the event. Similar to Earle's "A Colossal Problem" in the Monongah Mine.

As soon as the arena is released, the event starts and 3 gigantic robots spawn: the **Storm Goliaths Nona, Decima and Morta**. Each of them has **10,000 HP** and a **20% damage reduction**. Once 1 Storm Goliath is defeated, the remaining 2 receive a **40% damage reduction**. When there is only 1 Storm Goliath left, it receives **60% damage reduction**.

And another note from Mapex (Fallout 76 Datamining Discord): The damage reduction is completely canceled while a robot is on the ground (due to crippling).

*Tip: First shoot all 3 Storm Goliaths down to minimum HP, then kill them one by one. Crippling every now and then.*

The robots' attacks primarily deal **energy damage** and **melee damage**. And you should also keep an eye on the floor, the floor is regularly energized. When the robots raise their arms, there are bolts of energy from above that hit some places like rockets. At the same time, you are permanently “discovered” in the arena, which is not an optimal environment for command builds. However, several command builds in safe positions can certainly end the event quickly. Otherwise, heavy weapons, power armor and the legendary perk “power absorption” are recommended. I'm sure we'll all find out the best combination for ourselves soon.

When all 3 Storm Goliaths are defeated, you will receive legendary loot from all three as well as the event reward. If the event fails, the robots will drop dead, but you will still receive their loot, just not any loot from the event.

## Event Rewards

- 1200 XP
- 200 bottle caps
- 5 legendary cores
- 1-2 fluxes
- 3 government bonds
- 1-2 Rad-X or Rad-X diluted
- Contextual ammunition
- 1-3 Super Stimpacks
- 1 Stimpack
- 2-3 Improved Repair Kits

Plus one of these rewards:

- V63-OLGA (Vault-63 laser rifle)
 - Anti armor
 - +25% damage when aiming
 - +15% faster reload
 - Unique paint job
 -H
